notes: User-reported dashboard-delete bug fix (v1.11.27): deleting a task from the dashboard queued the auto-push, but when the Google event id could not be resolved the deletion loop in push_to_google silently skipped it — the push still reported ok: True with zero errors and the event survived in the calendar forever, with no signal anywhere. Now, when the box still has a pull link (uid_map) but its event id resolves from no source (ical_map, the one-day refresh, or the @google.com convention), a real error is recorded («حذف «عنوان»: رویدادش در تقویم پیدا نشد — حذف دوباره تلاش می‌شود») and the deletion stays pending, so the next auto-push retries it; the error is carried in last_push and shown in the Calendar tab. A box with no link at all (never linked, never created, already deleted and cleaned up by BUG-039, or pull-orphaned because its event is gone from the feed) is still silently skipped — there is no Google event to delete. The happy path is unchanged and the BUG-039 cleanup is untouched. New tests: TestDeleteRetry1127 (4 tests) + verify1127. Known totals unchanged: حسابان 3489, شیمی 3000; گسسته and فیزیک have none (2110 not reintroduced). The 1.11.18 examDateText live-computation fix is untouched.
